description: Add a section to an interview’s discussion guide. Sections group related items (e.g. "First impressions", "Checkout"); add questions and tasks to it next with add_interview_item, using the returned id as section_id.

interview_id.description: Interview UUID, from list_interviews or create_interview.

intro_script.description: What the interviewer says to open the section, setting context for its items. Omit for no introduction.

sort_order.description: Zero-based position in the guide (non-negative integer). Omit to append after the last section.

title.description: Section heading, 1 to 200 characters, e.g. "First impressions".

name: add_interview_section

id.description: Section UUID, the section_id add_interview_item takes.

title: Add interview section
